title: Cross-scale organisation of the atmospheric circulation: a falsification-grade research programme (Shroedinger, gen4)
description:
Falsification-grade research programme on the cross-scale organisation of the atmospheric circulation. This release supersedes v5.0 and records ten further preregistered phases (14-23) together with four methods audits (AUDIT-1..4). Every criterion was frozen before computation and every deviation is logged. The programme's analysis line closes with this release; the next work item is the manuscripts.

The object. P is the surrogate-anchored coupling between the spatial envelopes of adjacent scale bands of the 850 hPa relative vorticity field (bands 50-100-200-400 km; anchored against 99 phase surrogates per unit, which removes everything the power spectrum alone can produce). It is a regional invariant: season-, year- and ENSO-stable, replicated in MERRA-2 and in a free-running CMIP6 HighResMIP integration that assimilates no atmospheric observations.

What is new in this release.

  • The global map (936 tiles, 60S-60N) and its attribution. Maxima on the Southern Ocean ring and the Northern Hemisphere storm tracks; minima over the deep convective cores. Leave-one-sector-out R^2 = 0.536 against a conservative rotation null that certifies the non-zonal component (p = 0.001). Convective regime lowers P beyond the spectrum; storm-track activity raises it through the spectrum; orography acts on the spectral slope, not on P.
  • P has no accessible dynamics of its own. Fast (~10 h) memoryless relaxation to a static regional value, one clock common to all resolved scales (tau flat 9-11 h over 71-1131 km), no regime coupling, no ENSO modulation at 30x power over 1979-2024, and a whole class of derivative-based estimators shown invalid by identity.
  • A design control, not a statistical one, for the box-geometry confound. Equal-km regionalisation removes the confound by construction; the beyond-spectrum residual survives, lifting the conditional verdict of v5.0.
  • A theory candidate with scored predictions. Quenched-texture organisation (P as a functional of the local invariant measure over a quenched constraint field). A free-running model reproduces the global map tile-by-tile at 97 % of the attainable resolution ceiling; the effective dimension prediction passes (k80 = 1); the tropical interannual excess is coherent with the Interdecadal Pacific Oscillation; the sampling-clock prediction is supported. The strong "early-warning" form is FAILED and retired: P is an architecture registrar, not a sensitive reorganisation indicator. The forced-drift prediction remains open (detected in ERA5, unconfirmed in one transient free-running member).
  • Four methods audits on the estimator's novelty. P is not the amplitude-modulation coefficient of wall turbulence (rho = +0.14, robust at box scale and in a second year); not the Kolmogorov-Obukhov log-normal cascade correlation (rho = -0.42; the cascade prediction has no beyond-spectrum component at all). The rank/copula construction is decoration - the Pearson twin agrees at rho = +0.99 - so the papers cite cross-frequency amplitude-amplitude coupling as prior art for the form and claim novelty only for the object and its geography. The live relative is the local log-envelope variance (intermittency parameter), and that relationship is scale-dependent (rho = +0.69 at 700 km, +0.92 at 2800 km).
  • A correction that changes every share-of-ceiling statement in the record. The map's reliability ceiling, measured by within-season split-half agreement, is R^2 = 0.914, not the 0.603 cross-season figure used before. The attribution therefore explains 59 % of the reproducible variance, not 89 %; adding the intermittency battery reaches 83 %. What remains is itself reproducible (split-half 0.64), non-spectral, and organised on monsoon margins, orography flanks and deep-convective cores. Its drivers are named as future work.

What is retracted or retired. The v1 manuscript's central claim (the flux-closure result) stays retracted. The interpretation of the transfer-asymmetry index A stays retracted (it is a persistence statistic). The predictability claims of Phases 9-11 stay negative. The stratigraphic/early-warning form of the theory candidate is retired. The rank/copula language is retired as decoration.

Contents. Frozen preregistered protocols for Phases 1-23 and AUDIT-1..4 with deviation logs; the authoritative reconciliation scoreboard with all verdicts and retractions; the theory candidate document with its postulates, evidence map and falsification conditions; per-tile and per-region numerical results; the experiment catalogue; the manuscripts; and the complete catalogue of negative results.
notes: Supersedes release v5.0. Adds Phases 14-23, the theory candidate with scored predictions, and the four methods audits (AUDIT-1..4) that settle the estimator's novelty against prior art and correct the map's reliability ceiling from 0.603 to 0.914. The analysis programme closes with this release.
